note: Set "done": true when a milestone ships. Weeks follow research/physical_ai_research.md and research/kimi_research.md.

milestones.title: Order parts
milestones.detail: Order Phase 1 hands + Phase 2 arm servos in week 1: China lead times run 2-4 weeks to Toronto.

milestones.title: Print + sim
milestones.detail: Print InMoov hands and SO-101 parts at school. Set up LeRobot and the XLeRobot MuJoCo sim.

milestones.title: Hands alive + first arm
milestones.detail: Wire both hands (ESP32 + PCA9685 + 6V PSU). Build one SO-101 leader/follower pair, calibrate, teleop pick-and-place.

milestones.title: Full robot assembled
milestones.detail: Second arm, cart base, omni wheels, head + wrist cameras, battery. Teleop the whole robot.

milestones.title: First autonomy (ACT)
milestones.detail: Record 50-100 demos of one task (object into bin). Train ACT, measure success rate.

milestones.title: SmolVLA
milestones.detail: Fine-tune SmolVLA on our data, add async inference, reach 3 tidy/fetch tasks.

milestones.title: Cerebras brain
milestones.detail: System-2 VLM loop on Cerebras (~1 Hz): voice -> plan -> atomic commands -> VLM success check -> replan.

milestones.title: Kitchen prep demo
milestones.detail: "Bring me the sandwich ingredients" skill chain with VLM-judge recovery.

milestones.title: Robustness
milestones.detail: New objects, new lighting, mid-task interruptions. Log success rates.

milestones.title: Ship it
milestones.detail: Open-source release, demo video, write-up (fast System-2 vs slow System-2).
